learner: QDA: class-conditional Gaussians with full per-class covariance, biased ML estimates, no shrinkage, class-frequency priors, log-determinant term; ordered FP32 arithmetic as in reference.py

config.log: 40+40 halving/doubling steps, atanh series to z^15

dataset: 1000 train and 1000 disjoint test examples from the official 60000 training images
preprocessing: float32 image/255, exact area resize to 3x3, learner input 4*x-0.5
selection: Learner family and hyperparameters (no shrinkage, priors on, log-determinant on) chosen on disjoint pilot seeds 20261101-20261110 (mnist/small67/evidence/*.json: 67.59% mean over ten pilot draws); frozen before any official draw was evaluated
training: Deterministic closed form; no learner seed; no learned state transfer between draws
evaluator: Two-phase: freeze (hash predictions, no evaluation-label slices) then score (verify hashes first)
